name: Completion Tracker
description: Per-region completion accounting for the 100% run. It owns the region definitions — which collectibles, alcoves, and goals belong to which region — and the percentage math, because a completion percentage that three systems each compute their own way will disagree at exactly the moment a player goes for the last percent. It counts; it does not scatter. Collectible placement and pickup are the scatter system's job (its collected signal feeds region counts here), secrets announce themselves as world.alcoveDiscovered, and region goals arrive as progression.levelCompleted — this component is the ledger those events settle into. It does not own the reward for finishing a region, only the announcement that it happened, and it never reveals where the missing items are; that tease belongs to ui.guided_hint_system, which reads this ledger rather than keeping its own.

inputs.name: regions
inputs.description: Region definitions: id, display name, and the collectible, alcove, and goal counts that constitute 100% for that region.

inputs.name: countHiddenAlcoves
inputs.description: Whether secret alcoves count toward region completion. When false, secrets are bonus flavor and 100% stays reachable by the observable.

inputs.name: showUncollectedCounts
inputs.description: Whether the UI may show '137 of 142' per region. Hiding the denominator turns completion into pure exploration; showing it enables the hunt.

outputs.name: totalPercent
outputs.description: Overall completion across all regions. The number on the save file and in the 100%-run announcement.

outputs.name: regionPercents
outputs.description: Region id to percentage. The map screen renders directly from this.

outputs.name: remainingCounts
outputs.description: Region id to uncollected-item count. This is the output ui.guided_hint_system consumes to aim its pings.
